summary: Slink is a self-hosted platform for uploading and sharing images through drag-and-drop or single-click actions. It runs via Docker under the AGPL-3.0 licence, providing an alternative to third-party media hosts while keeping your files on your own infrastructure.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a dedicated, private endpoint for sharing screenshots or image files without relying on external services.
watchOut: The image-sharing category has many mature alternatives, meaning you should check whether its specific feature set meets your workflow before migrating.
deployNotes: Because it runs in Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your uploaded media and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
